matches.competition_format: 20-team double round-robin Serie A; 38 matches per club. Final table governs title, continental qualification and relegation; bottom four are relegated.
matches.qualification_state: Sao Paulo enter 10th on 43 points and need roughly two more points to reach the usual 45-point safety mark; Corinthians enter 17th on 36 points in the relegation zone, so Corinthians have acute survival need while Sao Paulo can effectively secure safety with a win.
matches.simultaneous_results_note: Round 34 is not a final simultaneous round.
matches.match_context_basis: This is a major Sao Paulo derby with survival consequences. Derby intensity can increase transitions and errors but also creates control risk; it is therefore treated as MIXED rather than automatically expansive.
matches.common_evidence_basis: In the second half of the league, Sao Paulo scored in all seven home matches (10 goals) while conceding five; Corinthians scored in all seven away matches (9 goals) but conceded 14, an average 2.0 per away match. Sao Paulo also recover Artur and can start a full-strength attacking group around Lucas/Calleri, while Corinthians retain Garro/Yuri Alberto but have defensive/availability absences.
matches.main_failure: Derby control and Sao Paulo's relatively strong home defense can hold the match at 1-0 or 1-1, especially if Corinthians' survival urgency turns cautious rather than expansive.
matches.supported_line_basis: A reliable Sao Paulo home scoring route plus Corinthians scoring in every second-half away match and conceding 2.0 per away match independently support G3; the derby/control endpoint prevents aggressive pre-XI expansion above G3.
matches.carrier_self_fund_basis: Sao Paulo's home attack is reliable but not currently strong enough to assume three goals alone against this derby opponent.
matches.independent_upper_tail_basis: Corinthians' away defensive leakage creates four-goal potential, but Sao Paulo's home defensive profile and derby control make the tail conditional rather than protected.
matches.upper_tail_transferability_basis: The upper-tail case is current league home/away evidence, but the derby context is less transferable than ordinary league matches.
matches.upper_tail_comparable_context_basis: Corinthians' away games are open, while Sao Paulo's home defense is substantially stronger; these signals conflict above G3.
matches.failure_attacks_route_basis: The failure mechanism is a low-scoring derby endpoint, not destruction of both scoring routes.
matches.material_suppression_basis: No current evidence erases both routes; both teams have scored consistently in the relevant home/away split.
matches.g3_current_structure_basis: Sao Paulo have scored in all seven second-half home matches and Corinthians in all seven second-half away matches while conceding heavily; current probable attacks preserve both routes.
matches.activation_basis: Corinthians' away profile combines a 100% scoring rate with 2.0 goals conceded per match, while Sao Paulo have scored in every relevant home match; relegation pressure raises the chance of a game state that must open.
matches.board_state_basis: Two current routes plus heavy Corinthians away leakage create a credible G3 case, subject to deterministic compilation.

matches.competition_format: 20-team double round-robin Serie A; 38 matches per club. Final table governs title, continental qualification and relegation; bottom four are relegated.
matches.qualification_state: Botafogo enter 12th on 39 points, only a few points above the relegation zone, so survival incentive is strong. Atletico-MG enter 7th on 50 points with continental-position incentive, but the club is prioritizing the upcoming Copa do Brasil semifinal and plans a heavily rotated league XI.
matches.simultaneous_results_note: Round 34 is not a final simultaneous round.
matches.match_context_basis: There is no major rivalry effect. The material context is Atletico-MG's verified rotation ahead of the Copa do Brasil semifinal, which suppresses the normal away attacking route while Botafogo's survival need is expansive; net effect is MIXED.
matches.common_evidence_basis: Botafogo enter after a 2-1 loss to Remo and have only one win in six under Tite; Tiquinho and Montoro are expected back, but the attack has been inconsistent. Atletico-MG arrive on four straight defeats and plan an alternative XI, with several first-choice attackers unavailable or rested for the Copa do Brasil semifinal.
matches.main_failure: Atletico-MG's rotated attack may contribute little, while Botafogo's current attack has not been reliable enough to self-fund three; 1-0, 1-1 and 2-0 are credible endpoints.
matches.supported_line_basis: Botafogo survival urgency and some Atletico defensive instability create goal potential, but the heavily rotated Atletico attack and Botafogo's own inconsistency do not independently protect G3.
matches.carrier_self_fund_basis: Botafogo's current attack has only one win in six under Tite and Tiquinho has one goal since returning; there is no reliable three-goal self-funding route.
matches.independent_upper_tail_basis: No current, lineup-transferable four-goal mechanism is established under Atletico's planned alternative XI.
matches.upper_tail_transferability_basis: Atletico's normal attacking profile does not transfer cleanly because starters are being held back for the cup semifinal.
matches.upper_tail_comparable_context_basis: The verified personnel downgrade and Botafogo's recent low-output attacking form suppress the upper tail.
matches.failure_attacks_route_basis: The failure directly attacks the away route but does not fully erase Botafogo's home scoring route.
matches.material_suppression_basis: The match is not globally suppressed because Botafogo's survival urgency and home attack remain live.
matches.activation_basis: Botafogo's survival need and the expected return of Tiquinho/Montoro can activate the home route, but Atletico's rotation and four-loss run lower the probability of a sustained two-sided game.
matches.board_state_basis: Current goal potential exists but the away route is materially weakened and G3 is not independently protected.
